summary.text:
• Arsenal were knocked out of the League Cup by fourth-tier Fleetwood. Merson called the performance poor, while Odegaard urged the squad to move on before Anfield.

• Thierry Henry defended his Ballon d'Or hosting, calling his comments "jokes", as Real Madrid apologized over the Mbappe controversy after he lost to Harry Kane.
